# awacino_member (Data Source)

One member, found by `id`, `email` or `external_id`. Key section **Users** (Read).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "awacino_member" "dieter" {
  external_id = "4711"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Invited address (case-insensitive).
- `external_id` (String) Your own id.
- `id` (String) Member id. Give exactly one of `id`, `email`, `external_id`.

### Read-Only

- `accepted_at` (String) Joined.
- `can_agentic` (Boolean) May use agentic AI.
- `can_automation` (Boolean) May use automation.
- `created_at` (String) Created.
- `display_name` (String) Display name.
- `role` (String) `main_admin`, `admin`, `auditor`, `user` or `read`.
- `status` (String) `invited`, `active` or `deactivated`.
